about: SHADOW SIX buildings & bridges (scripted Blender kit, tools/blender). URLs are relative to assets/models/. Game coords: x east, y up, z south, metres; pivot = ground centre, front faces +Z (south) at rot 0. LOD i is the first whose minZoom < zoom (realism-pipeline: zoom <= 0.8 uses LOD1). GLBs use EXT_meshopt_compression + KHR_mesh_quantization (GLTFLoader.setMeshoptDecoder) and reference shared textures by relative URI ../(..)/textures/lib/1k/.
